in_marathi.name: Mukunda
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of wealth and giver of boons
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mukunda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mukunda is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Mukta’ which means ‘to be free’. The name is associated with Lord Vishnu and is believed to bestow wealth and blessings upon the bearer. It is also considered a name of Lord Krishna, who is known as the ‘giver of boons’.
